method.daily_join: Same original reporting date; USGS daily mean is flow context for these original sampling locations.
method.geometry: Whole-reach polygon, original NLDI network relation, and gauge-specific split polygon remain separate. Same-reach source measures run from zero downstream to one hundred upstream. The original source-network relation is retained when supplied.
method.detection: Reported numeric values are unchanged. Present Below Quantification Limit is represented by [0, original limit), with no limit substitution.
method.chemistry: Same-activity unfiltered TKN plus nitrate/nitrite is a separate component-sum diagnostic. Original calculated Nitrogen values remain separate; source method identifiers and mass-basis qualification are retained.
method.weighting: Coverage uses unique station-date or network-date sets; nutrient rows do not multiply a sampled day. Flow-volume shares sum equal-duration original daily means.
method.quantiles: Nearest-rank annual thresholds; >=P95 defines extreme days, ties retained. Percentiles use midrank including equal daily means.
method.concentration: Interval means describe the retained samples within each flow stratum; no temporal interpolation or annual-load integration is performed.
method.event: Consecutive original >=annualP95 days; episodes split at calendar-year boundaries because thresholds differ.

regional_stream.geographic_meaning: Original stream station points are joined to the exact ARJWS polygons; Pioneer scope uses the source HUC8 and retained full utility union. Gauge network relationships remain original, separate fields.
regional_stream.quantity_meaning: Original nutrient sample concentrations retain constituent, fraction, method and units. USGS daily mean discharge supplies dated regional flow context. Annual NDR/SDR land-origin export and intake concentration use different quantities and support.
regional_stream.interpretation: Use the observed temporal coverage to plan sampling and inspect source components. An annual observed load requires a separately specified, geographically matched concentration/flow integration with uncertainty and transport assumptions.

methods.records: Every microbial source row remains in the original table. Detection conditions, reporting limits, field replicate and original comments remain separate.
methods.summaries: Station/year/method/activity/unit groups describe retained samples. Numeric-only statistics exclude censored/missing rows and state their measured counts. The explicit Information Only view uses the original ResultCommentText marker.
methods.temporal: Unique sampling dates count once within each displayed group; no campaign mean is presented as a calendar-year mean or annual load.
methods.geography: Native original utility memberships and station evidence are preserved separately from regional analogue observations.
methods.model_endpoint: NDR and SDR produce annual land-origin delivery to the modeled stream. Receiving-water concentration also depends on discharge and subsequent transport/processes.
methods.review: Needs expert review for site-specific sampling design and interpretation.
